technique_name: Describe the impact of climate change on the world's oceans.
description: Climate change is having a significant impact on the world's oceans. As the climate warms, the ocean absorbs much of the heat and stores it, leading to warmer and more acidic waters, which can have direct impacts on marine species. Warmer waters can cause coral bleaching, while more acidic water can lead to difficulty for oysters, mussels and other shellfish to build and maintain their shells.
